A local binding is (let name value expression). An optional value is handled by (case optional fallback binder expression_using_binder). A fold is (fold list initial accumulator row item step), where accumulator, row, and item are bare names visible inside step. There are no lambda or let* forms. Keep existing names and use only operations available in the packet or on this card.
